nodes.rationale: The graph must be exact and reproducible. The LLM only proposes inferred edges for configs without a collector in v2.

nodes.label: Deterministic Collectors and Parsers
nodes.rationale: Collectors have deterministic parsers so configuration and command output is not delegated to an LLM; remote collection commands must be read-only.

nodes.label: D-001 Web app in Docker, not a desktop app
nodes.norm_label: d-001 web app in docker, not a desktop app
nodes.rationale: Monitoring must run continuously; a web app avoids maintaining a cross-platform desktop shell and runs inside the private network. It requires login and must only be exposed through VPN or WireGuard.

nodes.label: D-002 Blazor Web App, Interactive Server render mode
nodes.norm_label: d-002 blazor web app, interactive server render mode
nodes.rationale: A single user on the same network benefits from live updates over the circuit without a separate API client layer.

nodes.label: D-003 SQLite with EF Core
nodes.rationale: A single-user tool needs no separate database server; data can live in one file on /data.

nodes.label: D-004 SSH.NET, agentless
nodes.rationale: Managed SSH avoids requiring an ssh binary in the image; port forwarding supports jump hosts and managed servers need no installed agent.

nodes.label: D-005 Microsoft.Extensions.AI with an OpenAI-compatible client
nodes.norm_label: d-005 microsoft.extensions.ai with an openai-compatible client
nodes.rationale: Microsoft.Extensions.AI provides one abstraction for Ollama, LM Studio, OpenRouter, and custom endpoints, with function invocation and a JSON-in-prompt fallback for models without native tool calling.

nodes.label: D-018 SSH.NET and pinned host keys
nodes.norm_label: d-018 ssh.net and pinned host keys
nodes.rationale: SSH.NET 2026.0.0 targets .NET 8 and higher and documents cancellable async APIs. Its host-key event defaults to trusting received keys, so the app must enforce exact host/port pins.

nodes.label: Repository as Project Memory
nodes.rationale: The repository’s handoff and decision documents preserve task state across sessions, tools, and models.

nodes.label: D-007 Vendored Cytoscape.js graph
nodes.rationale: Cytoscape.js supports compound nodes, ELK or dagre layouts, and graphs with 500 or more nodes; vendoring keeps the app usable offline.

nodes.label: D-008 Bento design and themes
nodes.rationale: The owner chose the visual direction in DESIGN.md; the personal tool uses English and left-to-right layout.

nodes.label: D-009 No Hangfire or Redis
nodes.rationale: Hosted services are sufficient for a single-process app.

nodes.label: D-010 ASP.NET Data Protection secrets
nodes.rationale: API keys and key passphrases must be encrypted at rest in SQLite, with the key ring stored on /data/keys.

nodes.label: D-011 Central test package management
nodes.rationale: T0.1 requires centrally managed package versions, and the .NET 10 xUnit template supplied compatible versions. New NuGet dependencies need a decision entry and central version.

nodes.label: D-012 NuGet package source mapping
nodes.rationale: Multiple global feeds caused NU1507 with central package management. Mapping public packages to nuget.org makes restore independent of machine-wide feed configuration.

nodes.label: D-013 EF Core 10 SQLite persistence
nodes.rationale: The official SQLite provider supports EF Core 10; the selected 10.0.14 release is the session's latest stable servicing release. EF Core packages stay on the same servicing version and committed migrations run at startup.

nodes.label: D-014 Self-hosted licensed UI fonts
nodes.rationale: The interface must work offline and the approved design specifies Plus Jakarta Sans and JetBrains Mono.

nodes.label: D-015 Container UID matches bind-mounted data
nodes.norm_label: d-015 container uid matches bind-mounted data
nodes.rationale: SQLite and Data Protection need write access to ./data, whose ownership follows the local host user when Compose creates the bind path.

nodes.label: D-016 Initialize bind-mount ownership before dropping privileges
nodes.norm_label: d-016 initialize bind-mount ownership before dropping privileges
nodes.rationale: Compose may create fresh bind-mount directories as root, so the entrypoint briefly initializes ownership before running the web process as a non-root identity.

nodes.label: D-017 OpenAI-compatible adapter and injectable HTTP transport
nodes.norm_label: d-017 openai-compatible adapter and injectable http transport
nodes.rationale: The current official adapter implements IChatClient for OpenAI-compatible endpoints and supports net10.0. Reusing the named llm HttpClient keeps model listing, SDK transport, endpoint behavior, and fake-handler tests consistent.
